about.metaDescription: Caring for your vision since 1996. Tus Ojos Eyecare serves Camden NJ, Cherry Hill NJ and Philadelphia PA with eye exams, eyewear and personalized care.

who.heading: Caring for your vision. Serving our community for generations.
who.p1: For decades, Tus Ojos Eyecare has been dedicated to helping individuals and families see clearly and protect their eye health through personalized, compassionate care.
who.p2: With convenient locations in Camden, New Jersey; Cherry Hill, New Jersey; and Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, we proudly serve the communities that have trusted us with their vision throughout the years.
who.p3: Our approach brings together professional eye care, modern vision solutions, and a wide selection of quality eyewear. From comprehensive eye exams and pediatric eye care to contact lenses, prescription eyewear, and specialized eye care, our team works to understand each patient's individual needs and provide the appropriate care and guidance.
who.closing: At Tus Ojos Eyecare, you're more than an appointment. You're part of the community we serve.

owner.photoAlt: Wilfredo Manzano, optician and owner of Tus Ojos Eyecare
owner.p1: Wilfredo Manzano was born in Puerto Rico and opened Tus Ojos in 1996. Nearly three decades on, he leads three offices — Philadelphia, Camden and Cherry Hill — the same way he ran the first one: listen before recommending.
owner.p2: As an optician, his work begins where the prescription ends. Turning a prescription into glasses someone will wear every day is as much conversation as craft: what they do for work, how many hours they spend on a screen, whether they drive at night, what bothered them about their last pair.
owner.p3: He has built his practice around strong and complex prescriptions, where the lens material, the treatment and the frame choice decide whether someone sees well or merely sees.

philosophy.heading: Your vision is personal. Your eye care should be too.
philosophy.lead: We believe exceptional eye care begins with listening.
philosophy.p1: Every patient has different visual needs, daily activities, concerns, and goals. That's why we take the time to understand what matters to you and explain your options clearly before recommending a vision solution or next step in your care.
philosophy.p2: Whether you're visiting us for a routine eye exam, selecting new eyewear, exploring contact lenses, or seeking care for an eye condition, our goal is to make every experience comfortable, informative, and personal.
philosophy.p3: We want you to leave Tus Ojos Eyecare feeling informed about your eye health, confident in your options, and supported by a team committed to your vision.
philosophy.closing: Your eyes. Your vision. Our commitment.
